about: Strut Health hair-loss intake forms, as served to an anonymous browser in the HTML of https://start.struthealth.com/flow/<id> on 2026-11-23 (PathwAI form builder, Next.js RSC payload). Four flows. Each flow: nodes (screens) with blocks, options and 'paths' (branch conditions), plus edges. Custom card source code is in components/. Per-flow files with scripts and component metadata: quiz-definition-<name>.json. Readable outline: quiz-compact-<name>.txt.
